import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.scatterplot(x='megapixels', y='price_usd', hue='sensor_type', 
                size='has_video_4k', alpha=0.6, data=df, legend='full',
                sizes=(50, 200))
plt.xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Camera Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type and 4K Video Capability', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(title='Sensor Type / 4K Video', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.xscale('log')
plt.yscale('log')
plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
